name: EasySecure Simple Gallery
author: imminentsoftwares

sections.description:
Need a simple image gallery that just works — without the bloat of a full-featured gallery suite? EasySecure Simple Gallery gives you beautiful, responsive galleries in minutes.

EasySecure Simple Gallery is a lightweight WordPress gallery plugin that lets you create responsive image galleries with Grid, Masonry, and List layouts — complete with a built-in lightbox, responsive column controls, and customizable spacing. No complex settings panels, no premium upsell nags, no unnecessary JavaScript libraries slowing down your site.

Create a gallery in the admin, drop a shortcode on any page, and you’re done. Your images look great on desktop, tablet, and mobile — automatically.

👉 3 Layout Options: Grid, Masonry (balanced & magazine style), and List — choose the layout that fits your content.

👉 Built-in Lightbox: Visitors can click any image to view it full-size in a smooth overlay. No extra lightbox plugin needed.

👉 Truly Lightweight: No jQuery UI, no heavy CSS frameworks, no bloat. Loads only what it needs.

Who Is This Plugin For?

EasySecure Simple Gallery is built for anyone who wants a clean, fast image gallery without the complexity of full-suite gallery plugins.

Photographers & Artists
Photographers love this plugin because the Masonry layout showcases images in their original aspect ratios — no awkward cropping. Combined with the built-in lightbox, visitors can browse a portfolio naturally and click any image for a full-size view.

Small Business Websites
Business site owners love the Grid layout for displaying team photos, office images, product showcases, or event galleries. Set the columns, adjust spacing, and the gallery matches your site’s design — no CSS knowledge needed.

Bloggers & Content Creators
Bloggers love how simple the workflow is — create a gallery, add images from the media library, paste the shortcode into a post. No page builders required, no block editor dependencies. It works everywhere.

Web Designers & Agencies
Designers building client sites love that the plugin is lightweight and conflict-free. No heavy dependencies that clash with themes or page builders. Responsive column controls for desktop, tablet, and mobile mean the gallery looks right on every device without custom CSS.

Real Estate & Property Listings
Real estate agents love the List layout for property image walkthroughs and the ability to control image width and background color — making property photos stand out on listing pages.

🎯 Layout Options

Grid Layout
* Clean, uniform grid with equal-sized image thumbnails.
* Perfect for team pages, product galleries, and any content where consistent sizing matters.

Masonry Layout
* Images displayed in their natural aspect ratios — no cropping.
* Two styles available: Balanced (evenly distributed) and Magazine (editorial feel).
* Ideal for photography portfolios, art galleries, and mixed-orientation image collections.

List Layout
* Images stacked vertically with full-width display.
* Great for step-by-step guides, property walkthroughs, or before/after showcases.

🎯 Customization & Display

  • Responsive column control — set different column counts for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Your gallery adapts to every screen size automatically.
  • Image spacing control — adjust the gap between images to match your site’s design.
  • Image background color — set a background color behind images for a polished, framed look.
  • Adjustable image width — control how large images appear within the gallery layout.
  • Built-in lightbox — click any image to view it full-size in a smooth overlay. No extra plugin required.

🔒 Lightweight & Fast

  • No bloat — no jQuery UI, no heavy frameworks, no unnecessary scripts. Loads only the CSS and JS your gallery needs.
  • No upsell nags — no persistent admin notices pushing you to upgrade.
  • Theme compatible — works with any properly coded WordPress theme.
  • Shortcode-based — works in the Classic Editor, Block Editor, page builders, and anywhere shortcodes are supported.
  • Mobile responsive — designed mobile-first, looks great on all screen sizes.

3 Steps to Create Your First Gallery

  1. Create a gallery — go to Galleries → Add New in the WordPress admin. Click “Add Images” and select photos from your media library.
  2. Choose your settings — pick a layout (Grid, Masonry, or List), set your columns, adjust spacing, and configure the lightbox.
  3. Add the shortcode — copy [easysiga_gallery id="123"] (replace 123 with your gallery ID) and paste it into any page or post.

Your gallery is live.

💡 When to Use Each Layout

  • Grid → Team pages, product showcases, event photos, client logos
  • Masonry → Photography portfolios, art collections, mixed-size image sets
  • List → Property walkthroughs, tutorials, before/after comparisons

Usage

Create a gallery and use this shortcode:

[easysiga_gallery id="123"]

Replace 123 with your gallery ID.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Galleries → Add New to create your first gallery.
  4. Add images from the media library, configure layout and display settings, and publish.
  5. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I add images to a gallery?

Click “Add Images” in the gallery editor. This opens the WordPress media library where you can select existing images or upload new ones. Select as many as you need and they’ll be added to the gallery.

How do I display a gallery on my site?

Each gallery gets a unique shortcode like [easysiga_gallery id="123"]. Copy the shortcode from the gallery editor and paste it into any page, post, or text widget.

Can I use multiple galleries on the same page?

Yes. Add multiple shortcodes with different gallery IDs on the same page and each gallery will render independently with its own layout and settings.

Can I change the layout after creating a gallery?

Yes. Open the gallery in the editor, switch between Grid, Masonry, or List in the settings panel, and save. The change takes effect immediately on the frontend.

Is the lightbox built in or do I need another plugin?

The lightbox is fully built in. When a visitor clicks an image, it opens in a full-size overlay. No extra lightbox plugin needed.

Does it work with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Yes. The shortcode works anywhere shortcodes are supported — Classic Editor, Block Editor, Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and others.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is intentionally lightweight — it loads only the minimal CSS and JavaScript needed for your gallery. No heavy frameworks, no unnecessary dependencies.

How do I control the gallery appearance on mobile?

The responsive column settings let you set separate column counts for desktop, tablet, and mobile. For example, you could show 4 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, and 1 on mobile.

Can I set a background color behind the images?

Yes. The image background color option in gallery settings lets you add a colored background behind each image — useful for creating a framed or padded look.

Does it support video?

Currently the plugin supports image galleries only. Video support may be added in a future update.
